review:
An Asian food game with a conveyor belt of five noodle bowls under the reels, each holding a prize or free spins. When the panda lands, he eats all five.

Every win removes the lowest-paying symbol and gives a respin, and seven respins in a row trigger free spins with multipliers up to 10x. Each win makes the next one more valuable – a great idea. Up to 5,100x and a 96.58% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
